title: NotificationConfiguration

TopicConfigurations.description: The topic to which notifications are sent and the events for which notifications are generated.

QueueConfigurations.description: The Amazon Simple Queue Service queues to publish messages to and the events for which to publish messages.

LambdaFunctionConfigurations.description: Describes the Lambda functions to invoke and the events for which to invoke them.

EventBridgeConfiguration.description: Enables delivery of events to Amazon EventBridge.

description: A container for specifying the notification configuration of the bucket. If this element is empty, notifications are turned off for the bucket.
